description: Compute the free-energy reaction profile of the nitrogen reduction reaction (NRR) on the Ru(001) HCP basal surface via the distal mechanism, under the Computational Hydrogen Electrode (CHE) model.
user_prompt: Compute the nitrogen reduction reaction (NRR) free-energy profile on the flat Ru(001) HCP basal surface (space group P6_3/mmc) via the associative distal mechanism under the Computational Hydrogen Electrode (CHE) model. The pathway begins with end-on N2 chemisorption, followed by six PCET steps proceeding through *NNH, *NNH2, *N, *NH, and *NH2 intermediates, with NH3 released after the third and sixth PCET steps. Build the CHE free-energy ladder at U = 0 V vs RHE and identify the potential-determining step. Report the free energy of the potential-determining PCET step, delta_G_rds = max(delta_G_1..6) (in eV), evaluated over the six PCET steps only.
